title: Bao Filling with Almond Butter and Earthy Mushrooms
description: A delicious and savory bao filling made with earthy mushrooms, gooey cheese, and almond butter, inspired by Chinese cuisine.
instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Add butter and cook until melted.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until tender.
Add sliced almonds and cook for 1 minute.
Add shredded cheese and stir until melted.
Mix in almond butter until well combined.
Split bao dough into individual pieces and fill with mushroom mixture.
Steam bao for 5-7 minutes or until cooked through.
